title: Mass. high school calls 3 separate shelters-in-place after students take THC edibles
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Local News The shelter-in-place orders allowed emergency crews to quickly reach individuals in need of care, Stoughton High School’s principal said.

Chris Carlson / AP, File By Abby Patkin October 7, 2026 | 11:46 AM 1 minute to read Stoughton High School weathered an “unusual” number of shelter-in-place calls Tuesday following reports that students had consumed THC marijuana edibles, according to school officials.

The three separate shelter-in-place orders allowed emergency medical personnel to quickly reach individuals in need of assistance, Principal Ryan Augusta explained in a letter to families, students, and staff.
